units.source_text: 阿泷回到旅馆，已是黎明时分，树干和河滩已呈现出白蒙蒙的影子。

en.t: By the time A-Taki returned to the inn, dawn had already come, and pale white shadows had begun to appear on the tree trunks and the riverbank.

units.source_text: 阿雪还在河边的澡塘里打盹。

en.t: A-Yuki was still dozing in the bathing pool by the river.

units.source_text: 她依然交抱着双臂，仿佛要紧紧抱住自己的贞操与道德……

en.t: She still had her arms folded across her chest, as if she were clutching tightly to her own chastity and morality...
